name: SearchAtlas
description_en:
Search Atlas combines SEO research, rank and site monitoring, content tools and agency reports with OTTO website optimization. Its current plans distinguish the number of projects, seats, OTTO sites, AI visibility access and execution credits. OTTO can move a recommendation through review and deployment, so evaluating it includes checking what reaches the website as well as what appears in the dashboard.

A practical evaluation keeps three records together: the selected page and proposed edit, the deployment method and state, and the observed live output. AI visibility measurements, credit usage and client delivery are separate checks. Public documentation contains conflicting pause and refresh descriptions, which need account/version confirmation rather than an assumed universal behavior.
description_zh:
Search Atlas 将 SEO 研究、排名及网站监测、内容工具和代理机构报告与 OTTO 网站优化结合。当前套餐区分项目、席位、OTTO 网站、AI 可见度访问及执行积分。OTTO 能把建议推进到审核和部署，评估时既要看仪表盘，也要核真实网站收到什么。

实际评估应并存三类记录：页面及拟议修改、部署方式与状态、线上真实输出。AI 可见度测量、积分消耗和客户交付是另几项核查。公开文档对暂停和刷新有冲突，需按账户／版本确认，不能假定统一行为。

core_features.explanation_en: Review original versus suggested content and choose category/page-level changes.
core_features.explanation_zh: 对照原文与建议内容，按类别／页面选改动。

core_features.explanation_en: Deployed Fixes records URLs, change types and timestamps; rollback is a separate documented action.
core_features.explanation_zh: Deployed Fixes 记 URL、改动类型及时间；回退为独立文档化动作。

core_features.explanation_en: Rank, visibility and citations describe different aspects of a monitored prompt panel.
core_features.explanation_zh: 排名、可见度及引用描述监测提示词集合的不同面向。

core_features.explanation_en: Share links or exports separately from scheduled executive-summary emails.
core_features.explanation_zh: 链接／导出与定时执行摘要邮件分别交付。

en: Review a small set of proposed OTTO fixes and verify their live rendering and rollback.
Interpret AI mentions and citations using dated snapshots rather than a single score.
Budget execution work and deliver client summaries alongside the appropriate full report.
zh: 审少量 OTTO 拟议修复，核线上呈现及回退。
按有日期快照解释 AI 提及／引用，不只看单分。
预算执行工作，按需把客户摘要与完整报告分别交付。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Inventory the site integration, SEO output and intended pages before engagement.
steps.zh: 启用前盘网站集成、SEO 输出及目标页面。

steps.en: Compare original/suggested changes and enable a small selected set.
steps.zh: 对照原文／建议，只允许少量选定项。

steps.en: Inspect the deployment record and actual page; test selective recovery in an authorized evaluation.
steps.zh: 核部署记录及真实页，在获授权评估中测试定向恢复。

steps.en: Record credit meters, snapshot timestamps, recipient access and cancellation/top-up conditions.
steps.zh: 记录积分池、快照时间、收件访问及取消／补充条件。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Current public monthly cards: Starter$99, Growth$199, Pro$399, Agency from$999. Included monthly Universal Credits:50000/120000/400000/1000000+; projects1/2/4/10 and seats1/3/5/10. OTTO sites follow those project counts. Starter lists no LLM Visibility projects/queries; Growth lists2projects/100queries on3platforms; Pro4/100 on6platforms. White-label starts at Pro. The page separately labels tracked-keyword/API limits and gives illustrative credit-funded rank-check examples; these are not one interchangeable allowance. Trial7days; no sustained-free entitlement established. Annual total, tax, trial payment requirements and final order conditions were not verified.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前公开月付卡：Starter $99、Growth $199、Pro $399、Agency 起$999；每月 Universal Credits 为50000／120000／400000／1000000+，项目1／2／4／10，席位1／3／5／10，OTTO 网站数跟随项目数。Starter 无 LLM Visibility 项目／查询；Growth 为2项目／100查询、3平台；Pro 为4／100、6平台。白标从 Pro 起。页面另列跟踪词／API 限制及积分能支付的排名检查示例，不能视为同一种可互换额度。试用7天，未确定持续免费权；年总额、税、试用支付要求及最终订单条件未核。

faq.question_en: Does an installed pixel mean OTTO is already changing the site?
faq.question_zh: 装 pixel 就代表 OTTO 已改站吗？
faq.answer_en: No. The guide separates detection from engagement and a deployed fix still needs a live-page check.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。指南区分检测与启用，已部署修复仍需读真实页核查。

faq.question_en: Will cancelling make every previous fix permanent?
faq.question_zh: 取消会让既有修复都变永久吗？
faq.answer_en: No such guarantee was established. Deep Freeze documents continued pixel delivery under specific conditions; native content and independent backups require separate checks.
faq.answer_zh: 未确定此保证。Deep Freeze 描述特定条件下继续 pixel 交付，原生内容及独立备份需另核。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Pixel detection and permission to optimize are separate states
sections.title_zh: 检测到 pixel 与允许优化是不同状态
sections.en: The installation guide distinguishes Pixel Installed from Engaged. Detection establishes that the script is present; engagement separately authorizes optimization. It asks users to confirm the correct domain, page coverage, active theme/tag-manager container and caching. Editorial evaluation: inventory the intended pages and existing SEO output, confirm detection, and review a small change before broad deployment. An installed script is not evidence that an edit was approved, applied or indexed. This research did not install a pixel, engage OTTO or modify a site.
sections.zh: 安装指南区分 Pixel Installed 与 Engaged：检测仅确定脚本存在，启用才另行允许优化。指南要求核域名、页面覆盖、活动主题／标签管理容器及缓存。编辑评估：盘预期页面及既有 SEO 输出，确认检测，再审小改动后扩部署。脚本已装不证明编辑已审、应用或收录。本研究未装 pixel、启用 OTTO 或改站。

sections.title_en: Review the enabled set before re-engaging automation
sections.title_zh: 重新启用前审清已允许的改动集合
sections.en: The review guide uses Disengaged as the pause state and offers original/suggested content plus per-category and per-page Enable/Disable controls. Re-engaging is documented to apply only enabled recommendations. It also reports that a UI toggle can disagree with a stuck backend job. Editorial review: preserve the proposed text, select a narrow page set and compare the actual page after the operation. If the state and behavior disagree, record the domain, toggle and timestamps for Support instead of assuming repeated clicks make publication safe.
sections.zh: 审核指南将 Disengaged 作为暂停状态，提供原文／建议及类别／单页 Enable／Disable；重启后应仅应用已允许项。它还称 UI 开关可能与卡住的后台任务不一致。编辑审核：保拟议文字，选小页面集，操作后对照真实页面。状态与行为不符时记域名、开关及时间交支持，不假定重复点击就能安全发布。

sections.title_en: Identify whether the result is a preview, rendered fix or native content
sections.title_zh: 确认结果属于预览、渲染修复还是原生内容
sections.en: The front-end guide describes browser-only preview, JavaScript injection for non-WordPress sites and server/plugin delivery through the WordPress integration. Its statements concern on-page fixes; they do not establish that every Search Atlas publishing action avoids CMS writes. Website Studio also has a documented connector/Worker requirement beyond manual script insertion. Editorial acceptance: inspect the output appropriate to that path—raw server HTML, rendered DOM and relevant CMS record—rather than expecting a preview to appear for every visitor or every injected fix in a CMS editor.
sections.zh: 前端指南描述浏览器独享预览、非 WordPress 的 JavaScript 注入及 WordPress 插件／服务端交付。这针对页面修复，不能确定 Search Atlas 所有发布动作都不写 CMS。Website Studio 另有连接器／Worker 要求，手贴脚本不足。编辑验收：按路径核服务端原 HTML、渲染 DOM 及相关 CMS 记录，不要求预览向全部访客显示，也不要求注入修复都出现于 CMS 编辑器。

sections.title_en: Pausing cannot be treated as a verified retention or rollback guarantee
sections.title_zh: 暂停不能当作已验证的保留或回退保证
sections.en: Two official guides disagree. Disable OTTO says deactivation stops the pixel serving changes while preserving settings/history; the review guide says disengaging only pauses future publishing and does not revert anything. These statements cannot establish one universal outcome for all integrations. Editorial transition: distinguish stopping new jobs, retaining existing rendered edits, native CMS content and explicitly undeploying a fix. Confirm the account’s integration and inspect the live page before relying on a pause for a migration or incident response. The conflict remains unresolved by this documentation-only research.
sections.zh: 两份官方指南说法不同：Disable OTTO 称停用后 pixel 停止提供改动、保设置／历史；审核指南称 disengage 只停后续发布、不回退任何内容。不能据此确定所有集成统一效果。编辑切换：区分停新任务、保既有渲染修改、原生 CMS 内容及明确撤回修复。迁移或故障处理依赖暂停前，先确认账户集成并读真实页面。本次纯文档研究未解决此冲突。

sections.title_en: Confirm a deployed record before reversing the specific change
sections.title_zh: 先确认部署记录，再回退具体改动
sections.en: Deployed Fixes/Activity lists page, fix type and timestamp; an absent item may still be suggested or pending. The rollback guide selects an individual fix or group, uses Undeploy/Revert and moves it back to a suggested state without undoing other fixes. It recommends checking the affected page afterward. Schema edits can overlap another plugin’s output, so editorial acceptance should inventory the active producers before changing responsibility. A successful dashboard action alone is not an observed clean page or a completed search-engine recrawl. No rollback was executed here.
sections.zh: Deployed Fixes／Activity 列页面、修复类型及时间，未见记录可能仍属建议／待处理。回退指南选单项或组，用 Undeploy／Revert，回建议状态且不撤其他修复，并要求事后看受影响页。Schema 可能与另一插件重叠，因此编辑验收应先盘活动输出方，再调整职责。仪表盘动作成功不等于已看到干净页面或搜索引擎已重抓。此处未执行回退。

sections.title_en: Deep Freeze preserves pixel delivery, not a standalone static backup
sections.title_zh: Deep Freeze 保留 pixel 交付，不是独立静态备份
sections.en: The Deep Freeze guide says approved bulk fixes are dynamically served, and frozen changes can remain after cancellation while the pixel stays installed. It describes automatic freezing24hours after an account becomes unsubscribed, with new optimization stopped and editing/rollback blocked until unfreezing. Removing the pixel, disengaging or deleting the project stops that delivery. The page says current plans include Deep Freeze but asks users to confirm account entitlement. Editorial exit: preserve an independent inventory and recovery route; frozen delivery does not prove the edits are permanently written into static HTML or will remain available without the service.
sections.zh: Deep Freeze 指南称批量批准修复动态提供，取消后可在 pixel 仍装时继续交付。它描述账户不再订阅24小时后自动冻结，停新优化，编辑／回退需先解冻。移除 pixel、disengage 或删项目会停交付。页面说当前套餐包含 Deep Freeze，但仍要求确认账户权。编辑退出：另保清单及恢复路径；冻结交付不证明编辑已永久写入静态 HTML，也不证明无需服务可永存。

sections.title_en: Rendered browser changes and AI citation outcomes require separate evidence
sections.title_zh: 浏览器渲染改动与 AI 引用效果需要分别取证
sections.en: Search Atlas explains that the pixel applies changes after the server sends HTML. A system that consumes only that raw HTML will not receive those later DOM changes. The article’s broader claims about every named AI engine’s JavaScript behavior were not independently verified or adopted. Editorial evaluation: identify which content is actually available through the relevant retrieval path, inspect source and rendered output separately and measure later citations under a fixed prompt panel. A browser-visible title edit is not proof that an AI system fetched it or will cite the page.
sections.zh: Search Atlas 解释 pixel 在服务器发送 HTML 后应用改动；仅读原 HTML 的系统不会取得后来的 DOM 修改。文章对全部所列 AI 引擎 JavaScript 行为的广泛说法未独立核实或采纳。编辑评估：确认相关检索路径实际拿到什么，分别核源码与渲染输出，再按固定提示词集合测以后引用。浏览器看见标题修改不证明 AI 已取到或会引用。

sections.title_en: A strong mention position can coexist with zero cited URLs
sections.title_zh: 提及位置良好也可以没有被引 URL
sections.en: The metrics guide distinguishes average appearance Rank, a composite Visibility Score using frequency/prominence, and Citations to specific URLs. A brand may be named without receiving a source link. The guide’s Share of Voice wording refers both to tracked-response share and the tracked-brand mention pool, without a complete formal denominator or weighting specification. Editorial comparison: inspect the underlying prompts and examples, record engine/date/brand scope and keep mention presence separate from citation acquisition. Do not convert a composite score into traffic, conversion or population-wide AI usage.
sections.zh: 指标指南区分平均出现位置 Rank、结合频率／显著性的综合 Visibility Score、指向具体 URL 的 Citations；品牌可被提及但无来源链接。Share of Voice 描述同时提到跟踪回答占比及跟踪品牌提及池，未给完整分母／权重公式。编辑比较：查提示词及实例，记引擎／日期／品牌范围，区分提及与取得引用；不把综合分数换成流量、转化或全部 AI 使用者总体。

sections.title_en: Use versioned refresh evidence rather than one promised cadence
sections.title_zh: 按版本核刷新，不只相信一个周期承诺
sections.en: A September30 guide says AI visibility refreshes monthly and has no manual refresh. The October15 release adds a Re-run Analysis button in Summary and moves AI Visibility to a top-level tab. It also corrects Rank Tracker’s NR tooltip from top20 to top100. These releases supersede a simple claim that no refresh control exists, but do not establish its cost, availability or every engine’s current collection cadence. Editorial reporting: retain the snapshot timestamp, active plan and selected engine; ask for the account-specific schedule when older and newer documentation disagree.
sections.zh: 9月30日指南称 AI 可见度按月刷新、没有手动刷新；10月15日版本新增 Summary 的 Re-run Analysis，并把 AI Visibility 移至一级标签，还将 Rank Tracker 的 NR 提示从前20改为前100。这使“无刷新控制”的简单说法过时，但不能确定成本、供应范围或全部引擎当前采集周期。编辑报告：保快照时间、活动套餐及所选引擎；新旧文档不同则确认账户实际计划。

sections.title_en: Monthly execution credits and HyperDrive credits are different pools
sections.title_zh: 月执行积分与 HyperDrive 积分是不同池
sections.en: Universal Credits documentation describes billing-anniversary resets and no rollover for included monthly credits, with usage logs by feature/date. HyperDrive covers separate indexing, local citations, Cloud Stacks and PR distribution; one pool cannot substitute for the other. Purchased rollover balances need their own terms. A reset guide describes per-seat quotas for some tiers while the UC guide describes shared team usage, so do not multiply the displayed credit card by every seat without confirmation. Editorial budget: inspect the exact action, meter, reset date and usage log before a batch or recurring job.
sections.zh: Universal Credits 文档描述按账单周年日重置、包含的月积分不滚存，并可按功能／日期查使用日志。HyperDrive 另用于索引、本地引文、Cloud Stacks 及新闻稿分发，两池不能互抵；购入滚存余额另按自身条件。重置指南对部分档位称每席位额度，UC 指南却称团队共池，因此未确认前不把价格卡积分乘席位数。编辑预算：批量或定时任务前核具体动作、计量池、重置日及日志。

sections.title_en: Automatic low-balance purchases differ from recurring credit packs
sections.title_zh: 余额触发购买与定期积分包不同
sections.en: The October10 top-up guide says auto top-up is off by default. When enabled, falling below the configured threshold—default5000credits—charges the saved payment method and adds credits; a large job can trigger multiple separate purchases. Three consecutive failed charges disable that feature. Separately, a checkout top-up can be a one-time or monthly recurring purchase, so turning off low-balance automation does not establish that every recurring pack is cancelled. Editorial review: read both Automatic top-up and Plans & Top-ups, preserve charge/usage records and resolve billing discrepancies with the vendor. No purchase or billing-setting change was made here.
sections.zh: 10月10日补充指南称自动补充默认关闭；启用后低于设定阈值（默认5000积分）会扣已存支付方式并加积分，大任务可触发多次独立购买，连续三次扣款失败会关功能。另外结账积分包可单次或按月续订，因此关余额触发自动化不等于取消所有定期包。编辑核查：同时看 Automatic top-up 与 Plans & Top-ups，保扣款／日志，向厂商核账单差异。此处未购买或改账单设置。

sections.title_en: A scheduled executive summary is not the full rendered report
sections.title_zh: 定时执行摘要不是完整渲染报告
sections.en: The October9 delivery guide offers a share link, optional PDF export and scheduled email as different outputs. It explicitly says automated emails currently contain an executive summary rather than the full report attachment/embed. Generate external links from the intended white-label portal if branding matters. Editorial acceptance: inspect a recipient-facing example and confirm its period, data refresh and access requirements. Link protection/expiry and complete export were not verified. Exporting or scheduling a report in documentation is not evidence that a client received it.
sections.zh: 10月9日交付指南区分共享链接、适用时 PDF 及定时邮件，并明确自动邮件目前含执行摘要、不附／嵌完整报告。需要品牌时从目标白标门户生成外链。编辑验收：审接收方实例，核期间、数据刷新及访问要求。链接保护／过期、完整导出未核。文档描述导出／排程不证明客户已收到。

sections.title_en: Access removal, email recipients and subscription expiry are separate controls
sections.title_zh: 撤访问、报告收件人及订阅到期是不同控制
sections.en: The account FAQ describes Admin full access and Viewer read-only, with seven-day invitations. Cancellation through Billing leaves access through the paid period; Pending can mean scheduled cancellation. It describes30days of read-only data after cancellation, but long-term archival/recovery and the precise window anchor need account confirmation. Removing a teammate is not by itself proof that old report recipient lists were cleared. Editorial offboarding: inspect project ownership/access, every recurring recipient and each separately purchased top-up before ending service. Preserve required data before relying on the vendor’s retention statement.
sections.zh: 账户 FAQ 描述 Admin 全访问、Viewer 只读、邀请有效七天。经 Billing 取消后保已付期内访问，Pending 可表示计划取消。它称取消后30天只读数据，但长期归档／恢复及准确起算点需账户确认。移除队员本身不证明旧报告收件列表已清。编辑离职／退出：结束服务前审项目所有权／访问、逐个定时收件人及独立积分包；依赖保留说法前保所需数据。

seo.title_en: Search Atlas: OTTO deployment, AI visibility, credits and reporting
seo.title_zh: Search Atlas：OTTO 部署、AI 可见度、积分及报告
seo.description_en: Evaluate Search Atlas review/deploy/rollback states, Deep Freeze, AI metrics, credit pools and client delivery from official sources.
seo.description_zh: 按官方来源评估 Search Atlas 审核／部署／回退、Deep Freeze、AI 指标、积分池及客户交付。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Search Atlas documented execution and client-delivery workflow
secondary_questions: Does pausing OTTO remove existing fixes?
How does Deep Freeze depend on the pixel?
What is sent in scheduled report emails?
How do auto top-ups differ from recurring packs?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: No account, pixel installation, CMS change, rollback, freeze, purchase or client delivery was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行账户、pixel 安装、CMS 改动、回退、冻结、购买或客户交付。

research_gaps.en: Conflicting pause effects, shared versus per-seat quota wording and current AI refresh controls/costs remain unresolved.
research_gaps.zh: 暂停效果、共池／每席位额度说法、当前 AI 刷新控制／成本冲突仍未解决。

research_gaps.en: Exact score weighting/denominators, per-action credit prices, current plugin defect status and full regional order terms remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 未核准确分数权重／分母、每动作积分价、当前插件缺陷状态及完整地区订单条件。

research_gaps.en: Long-term data retention, complete export, report access protections, UI languages and source-code license remain unknown.
research_gaps.zh: 长期数据保留、完整导出、报告访问保护、界面语言及源码许可仍未知。
